mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.5% in 20 days but S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (y/y) but S&P 500 returns are positive in >60% of subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline >1% in same month but S&P 500 returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strengthening that reduces recession risks and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high unemployment with labor market strengthening
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS rises >0.5% but S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) consistently indicate improving consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: HOUST rises >1% in month but S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of subsequent 5-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in >60% of subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises >0.25% and CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% in same month but S&P 500 returns are positive in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing economic output and corporate earnings growth expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0 but S&P 500 returns are positive in >60% of subsequent 60-day periods.
